User story: As a pet owner, I want to register so that I can keep my records private.
Acceptance criteria: Given an unused email and valid password, when I register, then an owner account is saved and the password is hashed. A duplicate email is rejected.

User story: As an owner, I want to sign in and out so that my account stays safe.
Acceptance criteria: Given a registered account, when I enter correct details, then I see my dashboard. Wrong details are rejected; after logout, private pages redirect to login.

User story: As an owner, I want to add and view my pets so that I can keep their details together.
Acceptance criteria: Given I am signed in, when I save a name and species, then the pet appears in my list. A second owner cannot view it by changing the URL.

User story: As an owner, I want to edit my pet details so that I can correct mistakes.
Acceptance criteria: Given I own a pet, when I save valid changes, then its profile shows the new values. A blank name is rejected.

User story: As an owner, I want to record care so that I know what my pet has received.
Acceptance criteria: Given my pet exists, when I save a vaccination, medication, allergy or treatment with a valid date, then it appears in that pet’s history.

User story: As an owner, I want to correct care records so that my history stays accurate.
Acceptance criteria: Given I own a record, when I edit or confirm deletion, then the history reflects the change; another owner is denied.

User story: As an owner, I want to add an appointment so that I know when to visit the clinic.
Acceptance criteria: Given my pet exists, when I save a valid clinic name and appointment date and time, then it appears in the appointment list.

User story: As an owner, I want to change or cancel appointments so that my schedule stays current.
Acceptance criteria: Given my appointment exists, when I change its date or cancel it, then the new time or cancelled status is shown; cancelled visits are not due reminders.

User story: As an owner, I want to see upcoming and overdue care so that I do not miss it.
Acceptance criteria: Given active dates include yesterday, today and tomorrow, when I open the dashboard, then yesterday is overdue and today and tomorrow are upcoming. Proposed upcoming window: seven days.

User story: As an owner, I want to filter and print records so that I can share a summary with my clinic.
Acceptance criteria: Given my pet has several record types, when I filter by type and print, then only matching records for my pet are displayed in a printable view.

User story: As an administrator, I want to disable an account so that access can be controlled.
Acceptance criteria: Given an admin is signed in, when an owner account is disabled, then its login and later protected requests are refused; owners cannot use this action.

User story: As an administrator, I want to see key audit events so that I can check account changes.
Acceptance criteria: Given an account is disabled or a care record changed, when an admin opens the audit view, then actor, action and time appear without record notes or passwords.

User story: As an owner, I want to remove a pet I no longer manage so that I can control my data.
Acceptance criteria: Given I own a pet, when I confirm removal, then it and linked care and appointment data are removed.

User story: As an owner, I want SMS or email reminders so that I can get alerts away from the site.
Acceptance criteria: If revisited in a later release, define consent, delivery and failure tests. Not part of this release.
